title: Arcwell — Governed Agentic CRM
content: A governed AI layer that analyzes CRM context, retrieves authorized knowledge, and proposes traceable actions without giving the model direct control over business data. Full-stack governed Agentic CRM reference implementation with tenant-scoped intelligence, typed tool proposals, deterministic authorization, atomic human approval, controlled connectors, and correlated audit trails. Arcwell is a FastAPI modular monolith with a React client and Celery workers. Its central trust boundary is explicit: models may analyze evidence and propose typed actions, while authenticated application services retain authority over mutations. The complete Docker profile runs PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, migrations, deterministic demo providers, the API, workers, and the frontend without requiring external credentials.

title: Arcwell — Governed Agentic CRM
content: CRM teams benefit from AI summaries, call analysis, internal knowledge retrieval, and next-step recommendations. The risk begins when probabilistic model output is treated as permission to change lead status, move an opportunity, or create downstream work without deterministic access checks, tenant isolation, concurrency control, and an accountable decision trail. Arcwell treats every model-generated mutation as untrusted structured input. LangGraph assembles authorized CRM and knowledge context, the provider returns Pydantic-validated proposals, and a deterministic policy engine decides whether each proposal is denied, permitted, or held for approval. Only a trusted application service can execute an approved command through a typed CRM connector. LangGraph account intelligence over tenant-scoped CRM and role-filtered knowledge; Typed proposals evaluated by deterministic policy before any sensitive CRM mutation; Atomic Manager/Admin approval with policy re-check and stale-value conflict protection; Correlated audit, execution, AI usage, automation, and transactional outbox records

title: SIHIA — AI-Powered HealthTech Platform
content: Hospital teams need to coordinate patient records, practitioners, appointments, waiting rooms, documents, and operational forecasts without fragmenting data across disconnected tools. A generic chatbot is not sufficient in this context: answers must be traceable, medical boundaries must be enforced, and the system must fail safely when evidence is missing. SIHIA unifies day-to-day hospital operations with secure role-based workflows, 7/30-day attendance forecasts, configurable notifications, and an administrable knowledge base.
